title: Take a 30 minute walk somewhere new
description: Pick a street you have never walked down and follow it for half an hour.

title: Do 50 push-ups before noon
description: Split them however you like. Photo of you mid-set.

title: Run to the highest point near you
description: Find the highest accessible point within walking distance and get there.

title: Draw the view from your window
description: Any medium. Ten minutes minimum. It does not have to be good.

title: Write a six-word story about today
description: Exactly six words. Photograph it written by hand.

title: Build something from what is in the room
description: No shopping. Use only what is already around you.

title: Compliment a stranger and mean it
description: Specific, not generic. Tell us how it went.

title: Call someone you have not spoken to in a year
Eat lunch with someone new
description: Someone you have never shared a meal with before.

title: Learn to say hello in three new languages
Read 20 pages of something difficult
description: Something you would not normally pick up.

title: Teach someone something you know well
description: Ten minutes, one person, one skill.

title: Watch the sunrise
description: Be outside before the sun is up. Photo at first light.

title: Take a bus to the end of its route
description: Any line. Ride it to the last stop and look around.

title: Spend an hour with no phone
description: Leave it behind. Tell us what you noticed.

title: The door that only opens in Ramadan
description: Find the side entrance that is unlocked only during the holy month, and photograph the lantern above it.
